name: MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund
source: 9M 2026 (period ended 30 September 2026) added from MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund Q3 2026 investor report statement of comprehensive income, NGX filing library; thousands of naira scaled to naira. Revenue is the printed Total Income 25,070,739. Operating Expenses is the printed 4,426,618. EBIT is the printed Operating profit 20,644,121. Net Finance Costs is the printed Dividend distribution 12,816,963. Income Tax is the printed Withholding tax 332,614. Net Profit is the printed Profit after tax 7,494,544; two lines differ from a straight subtraction by one thousand naira of the filer rounding and the printed figures are kept. EPS left blank: no earnings per unit line is printed. | MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund audited annual financial statements for the 10 months ended 31 December 2025 (Ernst and Young Nigeria, published on the NGX filing library), statement of comprehensive income, NGN thousands; and the Fund's unaudited Q2 2026 investor report for the six months ended 30 June 2026, NGN thousands. | CRON 20261128: EPS 9M 2026 left blank: the unaudited Q3 2026 statement (NGX doclib, MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund quarter 3 2026 financial statements, 4 pages) prints no earnings per share line and no unit count, so no per-unit figure can be shown honestly.

periodBasis.FY2025: 10 months ended 31 December 2025, audited. The Fund commenced operations on 17 March 2025, so this is its first and only annual period.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.note: Total income: interest on cash and cash equivalents, on financial assets at amortised cost and on mortgage loans. A fund has no cost of sales.

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.note: Total income less total operating expenses. The Fund reports no separate finance cost line.

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: Withholding tax as printed in the statement of comprehensive income.

rows.label: EPS
rows.derivedFrom: Net Profit divided by 2,500,000,000 units in issue, the unit count printed in the Q2 2026 statement of financial position.

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.note: H1 2026 uses total assets of NGN 269,882,972 thousand printed at 30 June 2026; the audited period-end balance sheet was not read for this row.

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.note: H1 2026 uses total equity of NGN 266,776,455 thousand printed at 30 June 2026.
